taskDescription: Drag the words into the correct boxes
resetDropDescription: Are you sure you want to reset this drop zone?
a11yCheck: Check the answers. The responses will be marked as correct, incorrect, or unanswered.
a11yShowSolution: Show the solution. The task will be marked with its correct solution.
a11yRetry: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.
textField:
The plot or the series of events that happen in our game from beginning to end is called the *storyline*.  
When a group works together to come up with lots of different ideas without judging them, this is called *brainstorming*.  
The main aim or what a character wants to achieve in their story is known as their *goal*.  
Figuring out which tasks need to be done and deciding who will do them is part of project *planning*.  
The background picture that shows where the action takes place on the screen is called a *backdrop*.  
A character or object that you can program to move and act in Scratch is called a *sprite*.  
When you change how a character looks by drawing on it, changing its colours, or erasing parts, you *customise* it.
